title: 회식 정중히 거절하기: "죄송한데요, 이번에는…"
objective: Turn down a 회식 invitation politely, give a reason with -느라고, and promise to join next time.
summary: Learn to politely decline a team dinner (회식) and give a reason with -느라고.
setting: An office in the late afternoon. Team leader 박 팀장 reminds Lina about tonight's team dinner, but Lina is moving next week.

task.title: Decline a team dinner
task.line: Pick, fill in, or write the Korean that turns down a 회식 politely.

words.meaning: a team dinner with coworkers, often after work
words.example: 이번 주 금요일에 부서 회식이 있어요.
words.exampleMeaning: Our department has a team dinner this Friday.

words.meaning: I'm sorry, but... (a soft way to start a refusal)
words.exampleMeaning: Sorry, but I'll head home first today.

words.meaning: I don't think I can... (softer than 못 해요)
words.example: 이번 토요일 모임은 가기 어려울 것 같아요.
words.exampleMeaning: I don't think I can go to the get-together this Saturday.

words.meaning: because I'm busy doing ~ (so I can't do something else). Don't add -었- before it.
words.example: 아침에 회의 준비하느라고 커피도 못 마셨어요.
words.exampleMeaning: I was so busy getting ready for the meeting this morning that I didn't even get to drink my coffee.

words.example: 비가 와서 등산은 못 가요. 어쩔 수 없죠, 뭐.
words.exampleMeaning: It's raining, so we can't go hiking. Oh well, it can't be helped.

words.meaning: definitely next time (a kind promise after saying no)
words.example: 오늘은 안 되고, 다음에 꼭 같이 밥 먹어요.
words.exampleMeaning: Today doesn't work, but let's definitely have a meal together next time.

dialogue.korean: 리나 씨, 오늘 저녁에 팀 회식 있는 거 알죠? 7시에 회사 앞 고깃집이에요.
dialogue.meaning: Lina, you know we have a team dinner tonight, right? It's at 7 at the barbecue place in front of the office.

dialogue.korean: 아, 팀장님, 정말 죄송한데요. 오늘은 참석하기 어려울 것 같아요.
dialogue.meaning: Oh, I'm really sorry, but I don't think I can make it tonight.

dialogue.korean: 다음 주에 이사를 해서요. 요즘 짐 싸느라고 정신이 없어요.
dialogue.meaning: I'm moving next week. I'm swamped these days with packing.

dialogue.korean: 아, 그렇구나. 그럼 어쩔 수 없죠.
dialogue.meaning: Oh, I see. Then it can't be helped.

dialogue.korean: 네, 다음 회식에는 꼭 참석할게요. 다들 맛있게 드세요.
dialogue.meaning: Yes, I'll be at the next one for sure. Enjoy your dinner, everyone.

exercises: Choose the correct form (야근하다: to work late): 어제 (야근하느라고 / 야근했느라고) 동창 모임에 못 갔어요.
Fill in the blank with 사다 + -느라고: 동생 생일 선물을 ____ 회식에 늦었어요.
Which line politely turns down a 회식? ① 죄송한데요, 이번 회식은 참석하기 어려울 것 같아요. ② 저 회식 안 가요.
Your manager says "어쩔 수 없죠." What does it mean? ① Then you have to come. ② It can't be helped.
Answer in Korean with -느라고: Your manager invites you to a 회식, but you are busy preparing for an exam (시험 준비하다). Turn it down politely.
answers: 죄송한데요, 이번 회식은 참석하기 어려울 것 같아요.
죄송한데요, 시험 준비하느라고 이번 회식은 참석하기 어려울 것 같아요. (Sample answer. Other polite answers with 시험 준비하느라고 are fine.)
